$comment: A site repository's own hygiene files: .editorconfig, .pre-commit-config.yaml, committed.toml and the .gitignore block: what is never committed (dumps, auth.json, .env) or always built (vendor, web/wp, uploads). Bedrock's own lines stay as they are (not absorbed: the template's .gitignore starts with Bedrock's, tests/bedrock-template.nix), and its web/app/plugins/* and theme lines stay outside the block, above the wordpress-init block that un-ignores committed premium code: the block goes to the end of the file, where a plugin wildcard would ignore that code again.
